Still stuck. The map shows walkable tiles all around me but I can't move. The notice board object at (2,7) is blocking my own tile.

Let me try pressing KeyE to read the notice — maybe the notice board needs to be read to be "removed" or maybe reading it is the intended interaction. But KeyE targets facing tile. Let me try facing up (2,6) and pressing E — already did, "nothing-there".

Hmm. Let me try a totally different input: maybe the game uses arrow keys or WASD differently. The controls say KeyW/KeyA/KeyS/KeyD move. Let me verify by trying to move the player... no, I control my own body.

Let me try holding KeyW and KeyD together (diagonal up-right).
